hypotheses.problem: The newly unlocked second stage has not been tested.
hypotheses.cause: The squad that already won has gained two visible equipment upgrades.

hypotheses.problem: The new mage's practical value is unknown.
hypotheses.cause: The mage is described as a complete output hero with clearing and burst capabilities.

hypotheses.problem: The new optional prison contains shields, rear guards, and healing that have not been tested.
hypotheses.cause: The current squad has repeatedly won and the mage has shown strong damage.

hypotheses.problem: The first prison attempt ended with the whole squad defeated.
hypotheses.cause: The team lacked sufficient strength at 50 equipped power.

hypotheses.problem: Progress has stalled on the optional prison branch.
hypotheses.cause: The current squad has a reliable main-route record and much more equipment than before.

hypotheses.problem: The prison's visible defenses and healing survived two prior attempts.
hypotheses.cause: The team previously lacked the newly obtained shield-breaking and armor-breaking equipment.

hypotheses.problem: The rescued ranger's practical contribution is unknown.
hypotheses.cause: The ranger is a complete sustained-damage hero and has a purpose-matched rare bow.

hypotheses.problem: Stage 7 has one high-health target requiring sustained focus.
hypotheses.cause: The active ranger is a proven sustained-damage hero with a mark-strength bow.

hypotheses.problem: Stage 8 introduces fragile casters and ranged support.
hypotheses.cause: The active team has proven ranged damage and substantially more equipment than at the prior clear.

hypotheses.problem: Stage 9 presents the first full four-enemy formation on this stretch.
hypotheses.cause: The active squad cleared stage 8 intact and gained two additional empty-slot upgrades.

hypotheses.problem: Stage 10 repeats a complete four-enemy formation at a later main-route tier.
hypotheses.cause: The active roster cleared stage 9 intact and then gained a rare support ring.

hypotheses.problem: The chapter boss presents a complete leader team.
hypotheses.cause: The current roster has three consecutive intact clears and two further active empty-slot upgrades.

hypotheses.problem: The new region begins with an unfamiliar mixed border patrol.
hypotheses.cause: The unchanged active roster cleared the prior boss intact and gained another weapon upgrade.

hypotheses.problem: The priest rescue applies sustained health pressure and ranged fire.
hypotheses.cause: The current squad has an intact entry clear and an active healer with upgraded support gear.

hypotheses.problem: The rescued priest's practical support value is unknown.
hypotheses.cause: It is a complete priest hero replacing a militia support in the same role.

hypotheses.problem: The remaining rescue combines a heavy front line with ranged fire.
hypotheses.cause: The current roster survived the flag trial intact, with proven priest support and two further upgrades.

hypotheses.problem: The trial detonates shields that exceed its threshold.
hypotheses.cause: The active priest has proven shielding and just equipped a chest with two shield-power affixes.

hypotheses.problem: The confluence combines the two earlier trial mechanics in one enemy team.
hypotheses.cause: The active roster cleared both component trials and then gained a 160-power mythic upgrade.

roster.note: 以节奏和团队增益放大队友，不依赖个人伤害证明价值。

roster.name: 林地游侠

roster.name: 夜幕刺客
roster.note: 擅长切入脆弱后排并收割低血目标。

roster.name: 灰契术士
roster.note: 通过持续伤害与诅咒压低高生命敌人。

roster.name: 晨祷牧师
roster.note: 完整治愈英雄，能持续治疗、制造护盾并保护低血队友。

roster.name: 白垒骑士
roster.note: 完整守护英雄，能承接集火、制造护盾并稳定前排。
